constraints: Follow .agents/skills/rust-coding-standards/ and AGENTS.md. Split any touched .rs file of 1000 or more lines.
Rust 1.83, edition 2021. No let-chains. Add no dependencies; Cargo.toml changes only by adding the [features] table.
Run cargo with CARGO_TERM_QUIET=true. Run nextest with NEXTEST_STATUS_LEVEL=fail NEXTEST_FAILURE_OUTPUT=immediate-final NEXTEST_HIDE_PROGRESS_BAR=1.

Decided spec items hold: the identifier rule, tabs at one per level, '{}' as the only nesting form, '( )' as a reader error, a '>' line continuing the pipe, 'key: value' as a pair, a dict over a BTreeMap, int=i32/int64/float=f32/float64 plus exact ratio, '_' as the wildcard only, '#@' as trivia, qualified names only after import, and the kernel forms match/fn/let/var/upd/->/{}/enum. There is no while/loop/break/when/unless/each.
The reader and expander never panic on untrusted input. The nesting cap is 128.
Core modules use no std::thread, fs, time, net or process.
Design 6.5.4 and 6.5.5 are normative. When a plan and the design differ, the design wins and the difference goes in the progress log.
Commits use the AGENTS.md six-section message with no AI attribution or Co-Authored-By line. Work on main. No PRs.
Only FE-FINAL edits vactrol-core.md, impl-plans/README.md and design-implementation.md (one sentence in 6.5.4, and the section 5.6 kick-sound wording fix).
designDecisionsAndRationale: The front end is split into four strictly serial plans: FE-VALUE, then FE-READER, then FE-EXPAND, then FE-FINAL. Each depends on the types from the previous one. Shared indexes are edited only in the final serial reconciliation wave.
Shell types (Closure, Pat, Sig, TexNode, VarSlotRef) derive only Debug and have no constructors. This keeps the section 4 layout and Value variants complete without implementing later tasks.
Diagnostics use a closed DiagCode enum with kebab-case names: 26 reader codes and 11 expander codes. misplaced-arrow is the plan's code for '->' inside '[..]', and FE-FINAL records it in 6.5.4.

The spec fixture manifest (tests/fixtures/spec/manifest.toml, 11 blocks from the 'vactrol' and 'vact' fences) pins reader and expander behavior against the spec documents, parsed by an in-repo TOML subset (no dependency).

User-QA U1-U5 are answered (2026-09-25) and binding: U1, the wasm32 target is installed and both wasm32 builds must pass; U2, a line-initial '>' is decided by indentation; U3, the escapes are \" \\ \n \t \{ \}; U4, fn bodies are block form only, and an inline body is malformed-fn (decided case, verbatim=false); U5, the bare-variant binding-if desugaring is kept (decided case), and the checker (TASK-004) must diagnose it.
intentionalTradeoffs: The vactrol-core.md progress entry is condensed so the file stays under 1000 lines (992 lines at plan time).
rustfmt runs per plan on owned files only. A crate-wide cargo fmt is deferred to FE-FINAL V4.
supportedEdgeCases: Byte-accurate spans with multi-byte UTF-8, and a \r in CRLF excluded from spans.
Console registers (_1) are allowed only under FileId::CONSOLE, and give console-register-in-file elsewhere.
Error recovery per statement: the next line still reads after a diagnostic.
Ratio overflow, including negating i64::MIN, and zero denominators become Failure, not panics.
Dict key total order: Exact before Float when equal as f64, -0.0 as 0, NaN keys as Type, and keywords ordered by name.
The if/elif/else chain nests into match, and both forms of binding if are handled.
Nesting of 129 levels gives nesting-too-deep. Every line-boundary prefix of all spec blocks reads without panic.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Evaluation semantics of the authority-question fixtures (fn f a b arity, let/upd base). These stay pending.
Distinguishing variant names from binding names in binding-if patterns (U5; a TASK-004 checker diagnostic).
Directive attachment to forms (editor 13.5), package fetching, and open semantics.
